I went on a New Year's trip to celebrate my 26th anniversary! It's been a while since I've been to Gangneung... ♥
The ocean is still beautiful no matter when I see it.
I booked my last train ticket on a whim, packed my bags, and went, and it was so, so good.

Thank you for watching today!

Next week, I'll be back with a wedding photoshoot vlog!
